exposure: TCM practitioners' understanding of chronic pelvic pain (CPP)
TCM practitioners' treatment strategies for CPP
TCM practitioners' integration of management and care for CPP into the health care system
outcome: Common diagnostic approaches used by TCM practitioners for CPP
Frequency of various TCM treatments (e.g., acupuncture, meditation, dietary changes) for CPP
Methods used by TCM practitioners to evaluate treatment efficacy for CPP
Reported limitations to TCM treatment for CPP
Sources of information guiding TCM practitioners' clinical decision-making
Referral networks and integration with other healthcare providers for CPP
cohort: The study included 122 registered Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioners in Australia and New Zealand who responded to an online survey.
finding: TCM practitioners commonly incorporate both traditional and modern diagnostic methods for women with CPP, monitor treatment progress using accepted measures, and often operate as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare approach.
